purpose: Authoritative source manifest for explainable land/corridor feasibility evidence. Public ownership is typed evidence, not automatic suitability.

sources.title: NSW Land Tenure
sources.publisher: NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development
notes: Dataset documentation warns roads, waterways and general public areas across Greater Sydney and Wollongong are not properly mapped in this version.
Use separate NSW cadastral road/rail corridor layers for corridor evidence rather than relying on tenure alone.

sources.title: Government Property Index
sources.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
sources.role: cross-check government ownership; not a suitability class

sources.title: Railway Corridor - NSW Land Parcel Property Theme - GDA2020 Service
sources.role: positive corridor evidence / existing reservation geometry

sources.title: Road Corridor - NSW Land Parcel Property Theme - GDA2020 Service
sources.role: existing corridor evidence; longitudinal compatibility and junction conflict remain separate questions

sources.title: Vicmap Property
sources.publisher: Victoria Department of Transport and Planning
sources.role: authoritative parcel geometry with Crown/freehold differentiation, cadastral roads and easements

sources.title: Vicmap Crown Land Tenure
sources.publisher: Victoria Department of Transport and Planning
sources.role: Crown tenure, reserves and government-road evidence

sources.title: 2021 Census Mesh Blocks
sources.role: fine-grained urban/development footprint and broad land-use class
notes: Mesh Blocks are the smallest ABS geography and broadly identify land use such as residential, commercial, industrial and parkland.

sources.title: Urban Centres and Localities 2021
sources.role: coarser settlement extent sanity/context layer; not sufficient alone for alignment penalties
